title: Consolidate Settings
acceptance: Settings keeps the reader's body and device: text size S/M/L, typeface override, Living Text, photosensitivity, reduced motion, volume, labels.
The accent, the imagery-through-words toggle and the ambient drone are removed.

evidence.note: Settings: Living Text row, S/M/L in both panels, mask switch and Ambient sound removed. App: livingText setting pushed live to the open Chamber; chamberMask and enableAmbient dropped. Chamber: Living Text gated by Settings, applyLivingTextSetting; legacy mask path removed (chamber-text-material loses legacyMask). Engine: stopSession no longer resumes the drone (it did by default after every reading). Navigator: Living Text switch removed. Setup: always asks for Living Text.
The lobby drone's playlist, its hidden-page re-arm and the three drone MP3s (2.5 MB fetched on every audio start) are removed.

summary: Settings holds what is true for every reading: text size S/M/L (a saved XL or Fit stays shown until another is picked), the typeface override, Living Text (on unless turned off; it gates every reading that asks, live), photosensitivity, reduced motion, volume and labels. The accent (B2b), the imagery-through-words switch (Inlay declares the word fill) and the lobby drone are gone, the drone's playlist and its three recordings with it (#495).
